channel.title: FridgePaper: Cleaning Schedules and Home Organization
channel.description: Free printables from FridgePaper for the Cleaning Schedules and Home Organization board.

item.title: Free Printable Weekly Cleaning Schedule (15 Minutes a Day)
item.description: Stop spending all Saturday cleaning. This free printable cleaning schedule splits the work into quick daily tasks, one room a day, and a few monthly jobs. Print it and check off as you go.

item.title: A 15-Minute Daily Cleaning Routine for Busy Families
item.description: Keep the house clean in just 15 minutes a day. Daily basics, one room per day, and a short monthly list, with a free printable weekly cleaning schedule.

item.title: Cleaning Checklist for Busy Moms: One Room a Day (Free Printable)
item.description: Spread the cleaning across the week so the weekend stays free. Quick daily tasks, one room each day, and a short list of monthly jobs. Print this weekly cleaning checklist and check it off as you go.

item.title: Daily Cleaning Routine for Working Moms: One Room a Day
item.description: A cleaning routine for busy families: 10 minutes of daily basics, then one room each day, Monday kitchen through Friday floors, with Sunday off. Includes a free printable weekly cleaning schedule.
